description:
Cast Mana Crypt by paying its mana cost.
Forensic Gadgeteer triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Clue, adding {U}.
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you would draw by causing each player to return a permanent to their hand instead.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to return Mana Crypt from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind.
Repeat.
